name: IBY_DIGITAL_PAYMENT_ACCOUNTS
description: This table stores the information about digital or virtual payment accounts.

columns.name: DIGITAL_PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Digital payment account identifier.

columns.name: TOKEN
columns.description: Substitute token for the digital instrument or account.

columns.name: TOKEN_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment token type. Values are from the lookup type ORA_IBY_TOKEN_TYPES.

columns.name: ALIAS
columns.description: Alias representing the digital payment account.

columns.name: ALIAS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Alias type. Values are from the lookup type ORA_IBY_DGTL_ACCT_ALIAS_TYPES.

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: Issuing payment system identifier.

columns.name: BEP_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account used to create the digital payment account.

columns.description: Process profile code used to create the digital payment account.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID

columns.description: Payment mode. Values are from the lookup type ORA_IBY_PAYMENT_MODE.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code of the digital account.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the digital account.

columns.name: OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Owner party of the digital payment account.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Issuing date for the digital payment account.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date for the digital payment account.

columns.name: MASKED_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Masked account name for display purposes.

columns.name: MASK_SETTING_CODE
columns.description: Mask setting. Values are from the lookup type IBY_INSTRUMENT_MASK_SETTINGS.

columns.name: UNMASKED_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of characters displayed unmasked.

columns.name: MAX_ALLOWED_USAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Maximum allowed usage count for the digital payment instrument.

columns.name: CURRENT_USAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Current usage count of the digital payment instrument.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the program or UI from which this row is created.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
